events.title: The Opening
events.description: The world unfolds from a single, contradictory premise. The contradiction is never resolved; it is merely distributed.

events.title: The Quiet Year
events.description: No chronicler writes for a whole year. What follows is shaped by the silence.

events.title: Aevris draws the first grain-map
events.description: Using a compass keyed to regret, Aevris charts a region that has not yet decided to exist.
